title: gorm.io/gorm
notes: gorm.Open on gorm.io/driver/sqlite :memory: (opened once): AutoMigrate, Create(&users) in one batch, then Where().Where().Order().Find(&found).
details: The connection pool is limited to one connection, since every new connection to :memory: is a separate empty database. gorm.io/driver/sqlite is built on mattn/go-sqlite3 (cgo). The rows of the fixture are read into plain structs in prepare, outside the timed call; the User structs are built inside it.
